headline: Riksbank and ECB Agree on T2 Technical Platform for Settlement
summary: Sweden's Riksbank and the European Central Bank have entered into an agreement to use the European technical platform T2 for the Riksbank's RIX-RTGS payment settlement service.
why: Integration into centralized European payment infrastructure enhances cross-border settlement efficiency and operational harmonization for central banks.

impacts.name: Sweden
impacts.why: Adopting the T2 platform standardizes domestic payment settlement infrastructure with Europe.
